title: PointScatter: Point Set Representation for Tubular Structure Extraction
mechanism: Split the image into scatter regions, each predicting a small point set, trained by greedy region-wise bipartite matching; points rendered as mask or centreline.
adaptation: Crack only on stride-4 features (16x16 regions); L1 point regression after matching lands at the mean of jittered labels (sub-pixel); render at source width.
min_experiment: Arm = PF + PointScatter crack head; baseline = PF; 5 seeds; metrics relF1@2, components found. Kill if relF1@2 gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: four public tubular datasets, segmentation and centreline extraction tasks.
